俺にも叶えたい願いがあるのでな。
text.official_en: I'm sorry. I have my own wish to fulfill.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ディートリヒ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この私を負かすとは……見事。
私は……満ち足りた……
text.official_en:
You've defeated me... Impressive... I find
myself...satisfied.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: ――試合終了！
text.official_en: The match is over!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
戦慄するほどの内容であったが、
最後まで立っていたのは……
text.official_en:
A heart-pounding contest! And who is
left standing?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: 炎の鬣！
text.official_en: The Fiery Mane!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
観衆よ、素晴らしき戦いを見せた
戦士たちに、あらん限りの称賛を！
text.official_en:
Shower all these warriors, who fought so valiantly,
with praise and admiration!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バーン・バーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.official_en: Rrrghhh...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それにしても、この男……
聞いていた以上に不気味なやつだ。
text.official_en: Our foe is even more disturbing than I'd heard.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バーン・バーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おまえは……
忘れたこともない、あのときの女か……
text.official_en: You...the woman from that day. I have not forgotten.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
生憎と、他人の恨みを買うことが多い身でな。
お前のような奴、いちいち覚えておれん。
text.official_en:
A throng of people desire revenge on me. You do
not stand out especially.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バーン・バーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ギギ……ギギギギ……
全員、冥界へ送ってやる……
text.official_en: Hnk... Oogh... I will send you all to the underworld...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バーン・バーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
おのれ……だが、
この程度でわれを止められるなどと……！
text.official_en: Curse you... But this will not stop me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_バーン・バーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: ギギ……ギギギギ……
text.official_en: Graah!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ゆくぞ！
我らの魂とこの戦いをユ・ファスに捧ぐ！
text.official_en:
To arms! We offer our souls and dedicate this fight
to Yu Phas!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ふうん……？
ユ・ファス、ねえ……
text.official_en: Huh. Yu Phas, eh?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それにしても、あんたってやつは、
なかなか大したタマだな！　王様！
text.official_en: You're something else, you know that?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そういうお前も、噂が本当ならば、
ダグザ大帝の血を継いでいるのだろう？
text.official_en:
As are you, if the rumors of you carrying the blood
of Dagda the Great are true.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
大したものだ。血筋的にはどこかの国の王に
なっていても何ら不思議ではなかろうに。
text.official_en:
Your pedigree is such that I shouldn't be surprised to
find you king of some nation or other.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
認めてもらったとこを悪いが、
俺にはそういうのは似合わんのさ。
text.official_en:
I appreciate the compliment, but that sort of thing
just isn't me.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
全力でいかせてもらうぜ。
こっちも、大事な野望がかかってるんでな。
text.official_en:
I'll be going all in. I have grand ambitions of my own
that I plan on seeing fulfilled.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いてて、やられちまったか。
それにしても、最後のは効いたな……
text.official_en: Owowow... You got me... I'll be feeling that last one.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_タリムーン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だがまあ、楽しかったぜ。
この俺様を負かすなんて、大したもんだ。
text.official_en:
Still, that was fun. I'm impressed you got the
better of me.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: ――勝負あり！
text.official_en: The match is decided!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
まれにみる激しい攻防の果てに
戦いを制したのは……
text.official_en:
After a battle of extraordinary intensity,
the winner is...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: メガエラの灯！
text.official_en: Megaira's Beacon!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
皆のものよ、この偉大なる勝者に
轟くほどの歓声を――！
text.official_en: Everyone, let's hear a roaring cheer!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
はじめに出会ったときから、
癇に障る<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en:
When we first met, I thought you to be little more
than a minor obstacle.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ゆくぞ！　お前をここで叩きのめし、
私達の腐れ縁の決着としてやろう。
text.official_en:
The time has come for me to defeat you and end
our ill-fated entanglement.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
何回も言って悪いけど、
オレ、絶対に負けるつもりなんてないから。
text.official_en:
I know you already know this, but I'm not planning
on losing this fight.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私を前に臆することもなく、か。
あのときの<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en:
You stand before me undaunted? I see that the boy
has come into his own.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
強いな……
この<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en:
The boy has grown strong. His skill has reached
new heights.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
偶然などではない……
そして、あの槍だけの力でもない。
text.official_en:
There is more to this than that new spear of his.
I doubt this is coincidence.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セオドラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: この<#CTRL:0E>
text.official_en:
How could he have attained such power in so short
a time?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
セオドラ姉ちゃん……
畜生、やっぱ、強いなあ……
text.official_en: Wow, Theodora... You're tough.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_カイ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
へへっ……
オレ、負けちゃったよ……
text.official_en: Haha... Guess I lose.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: ――試合終了！
text.official_en: The match is over!

US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
戦慄するほどの内容であったが、
最後まで立っていたのは……
text.official_en:
A heart-pounding contest! And who is

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: メガエラの灯！
text.official_en: Megaira's Beacon!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
観衆よ、素晴らしき戦いを見せた
戦士たちに、あらん限りの称賛を！
text.official_en:
Shower all these warriors, who fought so valiantly,
with praise and admiration!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あんたたちに比べたら、あたしらなんざ
名無しの雑草みたいなもんさ。
text.official_en:
Compared to this group, we must seem like
a bunch of boring weeds.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
だがね、今日は見せてやろうじゃないか。
雑草の意地ってやつをさ。
text.official_en:
But you know what? Today we're going to show
everyone just how stubborn a bunch of weeds can be.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
さあ、ダグシオン大剣闘祭で
でっかい爪痕を残してやろうじゃないか！
text.official_en:
Come on! The Heroic Games are a chance to make
our mark.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
パルマの雨の名前をダグシオン中に
知らしめてやるんだ！
text.official_en:
Let's see to it that everyone in Dagsion knows about
the Rains of Palma!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ああ……負けちまったか……
流石に勝てるとは思ってはなかったけどね。
text.official_en:
Aw, just like that, huh? Well, I knew I wasn't
gonna win anyway.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
我ながら善戦したってとこかな……
あの人も褒めてくれるだろうさ……
text.official_en:
At least I gave them a hell of a fight... I know that'd
make him proud.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp: ――それまで！
text.official_en: There we have it!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
戦いを制し、栄えある勝利を
その手に掴み取ったのは……
text.official_en: Emerging triumphant, after a glorious battle...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
音に聞こえた
西軍の強者たち！
text.official_en:
Just as the rumors would have you believe—
the fighters of the Western Division!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベラフィ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
市民たちよ、勝者に
惜しみない喝采を――！
text.official_en: Citizens, give a round of applause!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この男……すさまじい殺気だ。
それに、先程見せた技量……只者ではない。
text.official_en:
Who are you? You're the most intimidating fighter
I've met.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_グラディウス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
戦士同士の対話に言葉は要らぬ。
全力の応酬こそが何よりも雄弁に己を物語る。
text.official_en:
I think it's better to speak to fellow warriors with
blows, not words.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_グラディウス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
さあ……闘技場の白髪鬼とやら、
今この場で、お前の全てを私に曝け出すが良い。
text.official_en:
So come on, White-Maned Demon. Time for a
conversation!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
――！？
俺の血が……あの男と共鳴している？
text.official_en: I can almost sense...some strange kinship here.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
グルジン……
お前は一体、何者なんだ？
text.official_en: Who the hell are you?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_グラディウス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
すでに言ったはずだ！
言葉でのやりとりなど不要だと！
text.official_en: The person who's going to beat you.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アスワン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ベルトラン！
やっぱり、間違いないわ！
text.official_en: Bertrand! It's Bertrand!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アスワン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
雰囲気は変わっているけれど……
あれは確かにベルトランだわ！
text.official_en: Much-changed...but that's him! I know it is!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ギルキルス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……何だと！？
あれが……ベルトラン？
text.official_en: What did you say?! THAT is Bertrand?

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ギルキルス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……馬鹿な……
何故、お前が生きている……
text.official_en: How are you still alive?

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あれは……まさか、ギルキルス！？
それに、アスワン、君も一緒なのか……！！
text.official_en: That sounds like...Gilchris. And Aswan is with him!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_グラディウス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
未熟者が！
戦いの最中にどこを見ておる！
text.official_en:
Yes, keep gawking at the stands. That seems like a
winning strategy.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_グラディウス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
少しはやるようだが、まだまだだな。
お前の負けだ、小僧。
text.official_en:
You lose, kid. Don't get me wrong—you've got talent,
no doubt about it. But you've got a long way to go.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ギルキルス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そいつは悪魔だ！
殺せ！　今殺せ！　すぐ殺せ！
text.official_en: That man is a monster. Execute him. Do it at once!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_グラディウス
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……お前は生き残るがいい。
自分に何が足りぬのかを問い続けろ。
text.official_en:
You must survive. And you must keep asking
yourself what it is you lack.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
いったい何者なんだ、お前は。それに、その剣……
どこか覚えがあるもののような気がする。
text.official_en:
Who are you? The way you handle that sword—
it's strikingly familiar.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ガンシン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
悪いが、一切の手抜きはしない。
全力でいかせてもらう。
text.official_en:
Apologies—this is going to hurt. I am not the
merciful type.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
構わない。対戦相手に手心を求めた事など、
これまで一度たりとも無い。
text.official_en: That's fine. I've never asked an opponent for mercy.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ガンシン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……ならば、はじめよう。
お前は必ず、ここで私が潰す……！
text.official_en: As this unfolds, you may wish you had!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ガンシン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
白髪鬼、
お前はここで死ぬのだ！
text.official_en: Time to die, White-Maned Demon!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……お前の恨みを買った覚えは
俺には無いのだがな……
text.official_en:
I don't understand what I did to incur such a
strong grudge.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ガンシン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ま……まだ、だ。イリアナ様の前で……
無様な姿を晒すわけには……
text.official_en:
Failing so shamefully in front of Lady Iliana... I can't.
I won't.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……そのくらいにしておくがいい。
お前の身体は、とうに限界を迎えている筈だ。
text.official_en: I think you just did. Your body's too weak.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ガンシン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.official_en: Oogh...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……？
おい、どうした？
text.official_en: Are you... Oh.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……驚いたな、この男。
まさか、立ったまま気絶しているとは。
text.official_en:
Well, that's devotion. The man's still standing after
he passed out.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シンラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
遺言は、今のうちに残しておけ。
その程度であれば、待ってやらぬこともない。
text.official_en:
I will allow a moment for last rites before your
journey to the underworld.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
あいにくと、
俺はここで死ぬつもりはない。
text.official_en: No need. I'm not planning to go there anytime soon.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
やはり、あれは死の宣告者だ、間違いない……
あいつが、帰ってきおったんだ……
text.official_en: That's the Reaper—I'm sure of it. He's come back?

text.jp:
白髪鬼の魂を冥府に……
ユ・ファスのもとへ連れていくために……
text.official_en:
Here to deliver the White-Maned Demon to the
underworld, no doubt...to Yu Phas.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_シンラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
わが主のため……
お前はここで死ぬ定めだ。
text.official_en: As my master said, it is your fate to die. Today.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
確かに強い。大闘技場の
伝説となっているのも頷ける。
text.official_en:
The man's strong, to be sure. No wonder he became
a legend of the colosseum.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベルトラン
